title: Obligation register
description: Structured output produced by the obligation-mapping skill. One register per scoped engagement, containing many obligation rows. Downstream skills (control-matrix, policy-gap-review, evidence-binder, exam-brief, issue-writeup) consume this record by obligation_id.

register_id.description: Stable identifier for this register, scoped to the engagement.

as_of_date.description: The date this version of the register was produced.

scope_ref.description: Pointer to the scope record this register was produced under, when one exists.

process.description: Process, product, function, or domain the register covers.

register_type.description: Whether this register is a new build, a refresh against an updated source, or a re-mapping after a process change.

sources.description: The source list. If a source is not on the list, it is not a permitted citation in any row.

issuer.description: Regulator, agency, standard-setter, counterparty, or internal owner.

date.description: Publication, effective, or execution date as the source uses it.

open_question_summary.description: Open questions grouped by reviewer (legal, compliance, function head, sponsor) so routing is one read away.

applicability_notes.description: Rationale for not-applicable decisions and threshold reasoning for tier-dependent obligations.

confidence_label.description: Overall confidence label. Mixed is common; per-row confidence lives on each obligation.

human_review_required.description: Always true. The skill stops at draft; a named reviewer attests.

source_citation.description: Regulator or issuer, document, edition or date, URL. Free-text citation.

source_section.description: Section, paragraph, article, or clause reference. Mandatory; a bare URL is not a citation. Use [verify section] when the precise section is genuinely unknown.

requirement_summary.description: One sentence stating what specifically must be done and on whom.

applicability.description: Institution type, product, activity, geography, threshold.

effective_date.description: Effective date as the source defines it. Use ISO date when unambiguous; free text when the source uses a phrased trigger.

effective_date_phase_in.description: Phase-in stages where the source specifies them (tier-by-tier compliance dates, deferred-effective-date provisions, sunset clauses, transition periods).

impacted_process.description: Named process or function the obligation lands on.

control_objective.description: One sentence on the condition that must be true for the obligation to be satisfied.

evidence_required.description: What proves operation: named system-of-record outputs, records, sign-off logs, training rosters, model documentation, vendor file contents.

owner.description: Named role with accountability. Departments are not owners.

linked_control_ids.description: Foreign keys into a control-matrix output. Optional at extraction time.

confidence.description: Per-row confidence. High where source text is unambiguous; medium where interpretation is involved; low where reading between the lines or relying on a single secondary source.

tags.description: Optional tags: sector overlay, cross-cutting overlay, COSO component, or firm-overlay-defined taxonomy.
